GolfHub Perth 0.1.19

- See when your selected date is due to open for booking on each course's tee-time card, using Perth time.
- Published opening schedules are included for 12 courses. Hamersley's conflicting guidance is clearly marked as an estimate; other unconfirmed schedules say so rather than guessing a date.
- Course information distinguishes online release schedules from contact or walk-in arrangements across all 41 courses.
- Opening notices handle each selected date separately, preserve published availability, and prompt a fresh check when saved results predate the opening.
- Removed the separate "Plan your next round" section from Home.

Booking windows do not guarantee available spots. Course schedules can change.

GolfHub Perth 5.1.17

Update verification release.

This release has the same functionality as 5.1.16 with a higher version number so users can test the automatic download, installation and restart process.

It retains faster cached tee-time loading and the improved GitHub download compatibility introduced in 5.1.16.

To test, start from 5.1.16 and use Updates > Check now > Update now, or enable both automatic-update options and leave GolfHub idle with booking windows closed. After restarting, Updates should show 5.1.17.

If the update fails, use Open update log and share the error details. A successful update on the previously affected laptop is still to be confirmed.
